algorithm.title: Diagnosis and management of urge urinary incontinence

nodes.text: Urge incontinence: sudden compelling desire to void followed immediately by involuntary leakage from uninhibited detrusor contractions
Initial evaluation: obtain urinalysis to exclude urinary tract infection and measure post-void residual volume
First-line conservative management: initiate bladder training (scheduled voiding), pelvic floor muscle exercises, and fluid management
**Incontinence persists despite behavioral therapy:** administer oral antimuscarinics (oxybutynin, tolterodine) or beta-3 agonist (mirabegron)
**Refractory severe detrusor overactivity:** treat with intravesical onabotulinumtoxinA injections or sacral neuromodulation
Review and eliminate bladder irritants (caffeine, alcohol, artificial sweeteners) and optimize management of constipation
